def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    bg = grid[0][0]
    divider_color = 2
    div = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == divider_color]
    marks = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] not in (bg, divider_color)]
    if not div or not marks:
        return out
    # The divider is a full straight line; draw an 8-line just beyond
    # the colored object, on the side opposite the divider.
    if len({c for r, c in div}) == 1:
        dc = div[0][1]
        mc = [c for r, c in marks]
        target = max(mc) + 1 if max(mc) < dc else min(mc) - 1
        if 0 <= target < w:
            for r in range(h):
                out[r][target] = 8
    else:
        dr = div[0][0]
        mr = [r for r, c in marks]
        target = max(mr) + 1 if max(mr) < dr else min(mr) - 1
        if 0 <= target < h:
            out[target] = [8] * w
    return out
